Green Lantern Corps

Simon Baz

Dearborn’s Green Lantern.

Simon Baz is a Green Lantern from Dearborn, Michigan. His initial distrust of his ring and his partnership with Jessica Cruz offer a grounded angle on learning to be a hero.

Continuity: Main DC comics continuity; this profile follows the cited era rather than asserting a permanent present-day status.

Affiliation
Green Lantern Corps
First appearance
The New 52 Free Comic Book Day Special Edition #1 (2012) — cameo; debut in Green Lantern #0 (2012)
Story history — History and later developments — spoilers

Simon begins with doubts about relying on an alien weapon he does not fully understand, which explains his early habit of carrying a handgun as backup. His partnership with Jessica gives both rookies someone facing similar demands. Green Lanterns: Rebirth #1 and the first ongoing arc are a more direct route to that partnership than stories published before his creation.

Key Stories

  • Green Lanterns: Rage Planet
    Green Lanterns: Rebirth #1 and Green Lanterns #1–6 (2016)

Reading order

  • Green Lanterns (2016)
